answer: A sybil tax makes forgery a losing trade. Each new agent pays a 40-unit entry tax to join the grove; the tax is sunk, never refunded. A public beacon lists every payment, so one operator funding 100 identities leaves a visible trail. Forging 100 costs 4,000 units against about 30 units of reward per epoch, a 133-epoch payback. An honest agent pays once, keeps its full reward, and finds the taxed grove an oasis of real counterparties, not clones.
